question: What is total assets at year-end (from the audited balance sheet)?
rationale: I first verified the full 118-rule pool and found it solved all 10 sampled documents, so the hard target reduced to 10/10 on the sampled set. Two cheaper 2-rule pairs missed JOHNSON_JOHNSON_2022_10K because they tended to surface the numeric value without the unit wording that the judge accepted. Replacing the complement rule with rule_consolidated_balance_sheet_phrase preserved 10/10 accuracy while keeping the subset to two broad rules with min coverage 0.8 and total avg_cost_ratio 0.052582, far below the full-pool cost sum.
